newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - National Westminster cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - National Westminster cut.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said Tuesday it lowered its rating on the shares of National Westminster Plc to underperform, after a first half profits warnings and the departure of its investment banking chief.

-- On Monday, NatWest said Martin Owen, who has run NatWest Markets since 1992, was resigning and warned that the group would make no more than 770 million pounds ($1.3 billion) in the first half of the year, less than forecast.
-- On the New York Stock Exchange, its shares were off 1/2 at 73-1/2. In London, the shares were trading at 748 pence.
